title: WACS Functional Consultant - Pre-System
description:
Position: WACS Functional Consultant - Pre-System
Location: Remote

Published Summary: Are you an Oracle transformation expert ready to solve complex business challenges for global digital leaders? We are seeking a Functional Consultant to join a world-class Oracle practice—a Global Cloud Elite partner—to help clients navigate the future of work using AI, IoT, and automation.

In this role, you will be the bridge between business needs and technical execution. You'll use your creativity and analytical powers to configure cutting-edge Cloud Services, lead project workstreams, and help major organizations transform their asset management and utility operations.

Responsibilities:
Gather and analyze business requirements, refining features to determine acceptance criteria and solution approaches.
Create functional designs and configure Oracle Work and Asset Cloud Service (WACS) to meet specific business needs.
Develop prototypes to provide clients with design options and lead them through business transformation processes.
Collaborate closely with Technical Designers to ensure all solutions align with the overarching architecture.
Define and execute test cases covering critical business scenarios and manage small project teams as needed.

Qualifications:
Extensive experience working with Oracle Utilities applications, specifically Work and Asset Cloud Service (WACS).
Proven track record in gathering requirements, creating business process flows, and developing functional designs.
Strong ability to lead, coach, and advise project teams while maintaining high performance.
Bachelor's degree required (or equivalent professional experience).
Flexibility to travel (25%) based on client and business requirements.
Must be available to collaborate during Pacific Standard Time (PST) core business hours.
Key Skills: Oracle Utilities, WACS, Functional Design, Business Process Mapping, Requirements Gathering, Project Leadership, Agile, Digital Transformation.

Job Responsibilities
Lead Integration workstreams using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) for projects in Customer Cloud Service (CCS) and Work and Asset Cloud Service (WACS).
Develop and lead integration strategy, approach, and plan deliverables during the design phases of large-scale projects.
Facilitate client workshops to gather requirements and transform integration architecture into actionable artifacts.
Serve as a technical expert and mentor for both on and offshore teams, navigating complex administration and integration challenges.

title: Dynatrace Observability Engineer
description:
Position: Dynatrace Observability Engineer
Location: Remote
Terms: Long Term Contract


Top 3 Required Skills
Dynatrace Deployment/Troubleshooting: 7+ years, including SPL to DQL conversion.
Observability Expertise: 7+ years of extensive full-stack experience.
Splunk Administration: Solid understanding and hands-on experience.

Disqualifiers:
Lack of hands-on experience with Dynatrace dashboards or query language conversion.
Fewer than 7 years of observability experience.
Inability to work 100% allocation for the duration of the contract.

Role Summary:
The Dynatrace Engineer is responsible for deploying and managing Dynatrace, AppD, and Splunk to deliver full-stack observability across applications, infrastructure, and cloud platforms. This role focuses on building dashboards, alerts, and SLOs to proactively monitor system health and support incident resolution. You will work closely with development, operations, and SRE teams to instrument services, analyze telemetry, and optimize reliability through hands-on technical execution.

Responsibilities:
  1. Deploy and manage Dynatrace, AppD, and Splunk for full-stack observability.
  2. Build customized dashboards, alerts, and SLOs to detect performance issues.
  3. Perform hands-on instrumentation of services and analyze telemetry data.
  4. Support incident resolution and proactively monitor system health.
  5. Collaborate with SRE, development, and operations teams to optimize system reliability.
  6. Perform "hands-on-keyboard " tasks related to the specific tools and underlying operating systems.


Required Skills
  1. Dynatrace Expert: Extensive hands-on experience with deployment, troubleshooting, and dashboard creation.
  2. Query Languages: Proven experience converting SPL to DQL.
  3. Observability: Minimum 7 years of extensive experience in modern observability practices.
  4. Splunk: Solid technical understanding and administrative experience.
  5. Experience Level: Minimum 7 years of relevant experience; SRE Observability (P4 - Expert level).


Nice-to-Have Skills
  1. AppDynamics (AppD) administration.
  2. Experience in Systems Integration or Technology Services environments.
  3. Candidate Traits
  4. Technical expert capable of independent "hands-on-keyboard " work.
  5. Collaborative professional comfortable working across SRE and DevOps teams.



Job Responsibilities:
  • Manage the deployment and troubleshooting of Dynatrace and Splunk environments.
  • Create and optimize complex dashboards and alerting systems.
  • Convert legacy SPL queries to DQL to enhance data visualization.
  • Partner with SRE and DevOps teams to instrument services and improve system reliability.
  • Perform direct configuration and maintenance on monitoring tools and operating systems.
